action: No action needed; for awareness. Organisations with staff or customers in Jordan should expect Telegram to be unreachable; the directorate advises avoiding links from unknown sources and reporting banned content through official channels.
date_note: Date of the block as stated by IDN Times (Monday 16 November), published 19 November.
exec: Telegram is blocked across Jordan with no end date, which affects any business that reaches staff or customers there through the app.
plain: Jordan has blocked the Telegram messaging app across the country, saying it wants to stop extremist content, extortion and cybercrime. No end date was given.

sources.name: IDN Times: Cegah Konten Radikal dan Kejahatan Siber, Yordania Blokir Telegram

summary: IDN Times reports that Jordan blocked the Telegram app across the country on Monday 16 November. It cites a statement from the Public Security Directorate, relayed from Daily Sabah, giving the aims as stopping extremist ideology, extortion, threats, cybercrime and illegal content, and protecting national security. The article says authorities have set no end date for the block.
title: Jordan blocks Telegram nationwide, citing extremism and cybercrime

validation.note: IDN Times read; it relays the Public Security Directorate statement via Daily Sabah, which was not read. The directorate's own statement was not read.

review.note: Compared title, date 16 Nov, PSD statement relayed via Daily Sabah, reasons, no end date and advice against IDN Times; status confirmed rests on the quoted directorate statement
